report.explanation: Current telemetry is contradictory: gateway traces show one ERROR span calling order (1985ms), but gateway metrics show error_rate 0.0014 and p95 77ms with INFO 200 logs, and order traces are OK. Order shows retained heap after GC (340MB, WARN x10) but no memory-retention history to establish a leak. Deployment record alone cannot establish latency cause. Insufficient evidence for a bounded candidate; hand off.
missing_evidence: Order service heap profile / allocation timeline to confirm a growing leak versus steady retained heap
Baseline order memory_retained_bytes and retained_after_gc history to establish a trend
Gateway error-rate and p95 metrics over a longer window to confirm the alert
Trace-level error details for the gateway 'call order' ERROR span (status code, exception)
